On Wednesday you promised your sister to help move a couch. The van is booked for then. You have a paid ticket on the one o'clock coach. You choose your own plans. Your crew are Ellis on weather, June producing, and Cal on camera. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is optional, a small visible gesture with your own body or an observed prop while you carry out the selected action. It cannot move you to a second destination or give you an extra act. A line about an act does not perform it.
